## Checklist
- [ ] Tests were written first and are in the same commit as the implementation
- [ ] Each commit is one logical change and follows the commit standard
- [ ] `ruff`, `mypy` and `pytest` pass locally
- [ ] No secrets, real credentials or real customer data in code, fixtures or logs
- [ ] Daraja facts are labelled verified or community-reported, with a source
- [ ] An ADR is added or updated if this changes a decision
